description.value: Pho in Love is an authentic Vietnamese restaurant and bar on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, a busy commercial strip popular with locals and visitors alike. Sitting close to the Stanley Park seawall and beach cycling routes, it would be a natural stop for cyclists exploring the area. The bar component suggests a full-service dine-in experience beyond a quick noodle counter.
